Package com.esignal.jstandard.beans.marketdepth

Purpose of this package is to host all response beans related to MarketDepth data.

See: Description

  • Interface Summary 
    Interface Description
    AggregateDepthRecord
    Purpose of this class is to hold the additional properties for the Aggregate Depth information of any Market Maker information on different Market Depth types.
    BookByMarketMakerExtendedRecord
    Purpose of this class is to hold the additional properties for the Book By Market Maker Extended Record Depth information of any Market Maker information on different Market Depth types.
    BookByMarketMakerRecord
    Purpose of this class is to hold the additional properties for the Book By Market Maker Record Depth information of any Market Maker information on different Market Depth types.
    BookByPriceRecord
    Purpose of this class is to hold the additional properties for the Book By Price Record Depth information of any Market Maker information on different Market Depth types.
    MarketDepth
    Purpose of this class is to hold properties of any Market Maker information on different Market Depth types.
    MarketDepth.Ask
    This interface extends Market Depth record interface.
    MarketDepth.Bid
    This interface extends Market Depth record interface.
    MarketDepth.Record
    This interface is the base interface of the different Market Maker information.
    MarketDepthRequest
    The Purpose of this interface is to provide possible request options while making a request or subscription for all the different MarketDepth requests .
    NetOrderImbalanceRecord
    Purpose of this class is to hold Net Order Imbalance Record information.
    NetOrderImbalanceRequest
    The Purpose of this interface is to provide possible request options while making a request or subscription for Net Order Imbalance Depth information.
    OrderBookRecord
    Purpose of this class is to hold the additional properties for the Order Book Record Depth information of any Market Maker information on different Market Depth types.
